reason: The superseded preflight admitted a runtime-presence coordination predicate bound only to runtime profile plus WorkerCoordinator class. Commit a3cde34c0ddc1312236eac6f0220b0f9f2a54ff2 removed that over-broad predicate and restored deferral because cross-task reuse requires authentic runtime_root and resident.node_id subject identity. The historical PASS remains preserved as evidence of the prior evaluation but is not current admissibility authority.
required_before_re_admission: subject binding includes concrete runtime_root identity
subject binding includes resident.node_id when available from authentic evidence
subject binding includes canonical WorkerCoordinator identity
consumer grouping is limited to tasks proven to target the same bound subject
freshness and NONE_OBSERVATION_ONLY authority constraints still qualify
